character_bank.char_a: Domestic shorthair cat, golden-orange tabby with white paws and a white chest patch. Bright amber eyes. Medium build, soft fluffy fur. About 3 years old. Wears no collar.

acts.title: The Window
acts.summary: A golden tabby cat stands before a rain-streaked window, mesmerized by droplets racing down the glass.

scenes.description: A gentle overcast afternoon. Rain sheets against a large bay window. The orange tabby stands on its hind legs, front paws pressed to the glass, watching droplets cascade downward.

shots.description: Wide establishing shot of the living room interior. Rain-latticed window dominates the frame. The cat is a small warm shape against the cool blue-grey light from outside.
Close-up on the cat's paw pressing against the rain-coated glass. Droplets scatter around its white-tipped toes. The reflection of the cat's face is faintly visible in the window.

acts.title: The Descent
acts.summary: The cat trails a single raindrop with its nose and paw, curiosity peaking as it tracks the water's path.

scenes.description: The cat leans closer, nose almost touching the glass. It follows one particular droplet as it snakes downward, occasionally batting at it with a white paw.

shots.description: Medium close-up of the cat's face in profile. Raindrops blur the background into soft bokeh. Its amber eyes are wide, pupils dilated, reflecting the grey light.
Extreme close-up of a single raindrop sliding down the glass, the cat's blurred nose and paw visible behind it, batting gently at it.

acts.title: Sleep
acts.summary: Exhausted from its vigil, the cat curls onto a plush blanket near the window and drifts off as the rain continues its steady rhythm.

scenes.description: The light has softened to a deep indigo. The cat leaps down from the windowsill and lands silently on a厚 wool blanket. It circles twice, settles into a tight curl, and its breathing deepens.

shots.description: Wide shot, dimming natural light filtering through the rainy window. The cat curls on a cream-colored blanket. Rain continues to trace paths on the glass. Slow fade to black.
